#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#define MAX_SIZE 7100
typedef long long ll;
#define INF 1000000000
using namespace std;

struct FlowNetwork {
    struct Edge {
        int from, to;
        ll flow, capacity;
    };
    
    int s, t;
    vector<Edge> edges;
    vector<int> adj[MAX_SIZE];
    int level[MAX_SIZE], seen[MAX_SIZE];
    int ptr[MAX_SIZE];
    
    void init() {
        edges.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; ++i) adj[i].clear();
    }
    
    void addEdge(int from, int to, ll cap) {
        edges.push_back({from, to, 0ll, cap});
        edges.push_back({to, from, 0ll, 0ll});
        adj[from].push_back((int)edges.size() - 2);
        adj[to].push_back((int)edges.size() - 1);
    }
    
    bool bfs() {
        fill(seen, seen + MAX_SIZE, 0);
        fill(level, level + MAX_SIZE, 0);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        seen[s] = 1;
        level[s] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)adj[v].size(); ++i) {
                Edge &e = edges[adj[v][i]];
                int nxt = e.to;
                if (!seen[nxt] && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                    level[nxt] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.push(nxt);
                    seen[nxt] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return seen[t];
    }
    
    ll dfs(int x, ll cp) {
        if (x == t || cp == 0) return cp;
        ll flow = 0, newflow;
        for (int &y = ptr[x]; y < (int)adj[x].size(); ++y) {
            Edge &e = edges[adj[x][y]];
            if (level[x] + 1 == level[e.to]) {
                ll minn = min(cp, e.capacity - e.flow);
                newflow = dfs(e.to, minn);
                if (newflow > 0) {
                    e.flow += newflow;
                    edges[adj[x][y] ^ 1].flow -= newflow;
                    flow += newflow;
                    cp -= newflow;
                    if (cp == 0) break;
                }
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }
    
    ll dinic() {
        ll flow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            fill(ptr, ptr + MAX_SIZE, 0);
            flow += dfs(s, INF);
        }
        return flow;
    }
};

bool visited[14][14];
int dist[14][14];
int n, tgt[103];

    queue<pair<pair<int,int>,int>> q;
    for (int i = 0; i < 14; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < 14; ++j)
            dist[i][j] = 111;
    dist[x][y] = 0;
    q.push({{x, y}, 0});
    int dx[4] = {1, 0, 0, -1}, dy[4] = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto p = q.front(); q.pop();
        if (visited[p.first.first][p.first.second]) continue;
        visited[p.first.first][p.first.second] = true;
        dist[p.first.first][p.first.second] = p.second;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
            int tx = dx[i] + p.first.first, ty = dy[i] + p.first.second;
            if (tx <= 0 || tx > n || ty <= 0 || ty > n || visited[tx][ty] || g1[tx][ty] == 'Y')
                continue;
            q.push({{tx, ty}, p.second + 1});
        }
    }
}

    return level * n * n + (x - 1) * n + y;

    mf.s = 0; mf.t = MAX_SIZE - 2;
    int x = 0, y = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            if (g1[i][j] == 'Z') { x = i; y = j; break; }
        }
    }
    
    for (i = 1; i <= n * n; ++i) tgt[i] = MAX_SIZE - 3 - (n * n - i);
    
    computeDist(x, y);
    
    for (i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            if (g1[i][j] >= '0' && g1[i][j] <= '9')
                mf.addEdge(mf.s, idx(0, i, j), g1[i][j] - '0');
            if (g2[i][j] >= '0' && g2[i][j] <= '9')
                mf.addEdge(tgt[idx(0, i, j)], mf.t, g2[i][j] - '0');
            mf.addEdge(idx(0, i, j), tgt[idx(0, i, j)], INF);
        }

    for (i = 1; i <= t; ++i) {
        for (j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {

                if (g1[j][k] == 'Y' || g1[j][k] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int l = 0; l < 4; ++l) {
                    int tx = dx[l] + j, ty = dy[l] + k;
